Thanks for reaching out to Grow Green. Our team will review your property details and contact you about your lawn fertilization and weed control estimate. This is a quote request, not a scheduled treatment.
Grass type, sunlight, moisture, and weed pressure all matter. Tell us where the lawn struggles so we can consider the conditions behind those thin spots or changes in color.
Seasonal liquid nutrition supports active turf growth. Weed prevention and targeted treatments address different weed pressures, using products appropriate for your grass and the conditions.
We track the lawn’s response, watch for insect and disease concerns, and adjust care as conditions change. Service photos and notes help you follow the work and understand any aftercare.
Care through South Louisiana’s seasons
Active growth, summer heat, rainfall, and seasonal weeds influence lawn care in Plaquemine. We adjust the work to the turf and conditions so each visit has a clear purpose.
Time feeding to active growth, address early weeds, and use preventive treatments at appropriate seasonal windows.
Adjust nutrition and weed control for heat, moisture, and turf response while monitoring seasonal insect activity.
Shift nutrition as growth slows, manage cool-season weed pressure, and watch for seasonal disease concerns.
Monitor lawn conditions and winter weeds. Dormant warm-season grass does not need the same nitrogen feeding as actively growing summer turf.
This is an overview of seasonal priorities. Actual products, rates, and visit timing depend on turf needs, weather, and label directions.
Know the grass. Match the care.
Good fertilization starts with the grass you have. We consider the turf alongside sunlight, moisture, and mowing so the plan supports healthy growth without adding more than the lawn needs.
Learn more: LSU AgCenter’s Louisiana Lawn Maintenance guide (PDF) and UF/IFAS centipedegrass guidance .
Local people behind your lawn care

Grow Green is a firefighter-owned lawn-treatment company based in St. Amant, serving Plaquemine and other South Louisiana communities. Dereck and the team put a local name behind the care your lawn receives.

You get straightforward pricing, service photos and notes, and an office you can reach when a concern comes up. Contact us between visits if you notice a change so we can review it and explain the appropriate next step.

What to know about your estimate, treatment visits, and the everyday care that supports your lawn.

Our annual lawn program includes seasonal planned visits, generally about six weeks apart. Treatments vary with the season, turf condition, and weather. Each visit serves a purpose; eight visits do not mean eight identical fertilizer applications.

Your free estimate depends on the measured treatable lawn area, property conditions, and selected services. We explain the price and scope before you approve. The annual year-round lawn program price is divided into twelve monthly payments. Service is month-to-month with no long-term contract; monthly billing does not mean monthly treatments.

Yes. The lawn program combines seasonal weed prevention with targeted control of existing weeds. Product choices depend on the grass, weeds, weather, and label directions. Persistent weeds may require continued management or additional targeted treatment, which we review with you.

We work with warm-season lawns including centipede, St. Augustine, Bermuda, and zoysia. Nutrition and weed-control choices are adjusted to the grass and site conditions. If you do not know your grass type, include that in your estimate request.

We provide lawn treatments in Plaquemine as part of our Iberville Parish service area. Send your street address and ZIP code so we can confirm availability and prepare pricing for the property. Our team can also check addresses in nearby communities.

Weed response and turf improvement depend on the species, growing conditions, and starting condition of the lawn. Some changes happen sooner than others, while thin areas need suitable growing conditions and time to fill in. We explain what to expect and review progress through the program.

Usually not, as long as we can access the scheduled treatment area. Unlock gates, secure pets, and tell us about access restrictions or sensitive areas. We document the visit with photos and notes and provide directions for caring for the treated lawn.

Keep people and pets away from the treatment area during application. Follow the specific re-entry directions provided for the products used. A single waiting period does not apply to every treatment.

structured.hero_sub: Put consistent care behind your lawn. Our local team combines liquid fertilization, seasonal weed control, and regular lawn monitoring to help Plaquemine lawns grow healthier through the year.
structured.local_title: A year of lawn care. A clear monthly price.
structured.local_lead: Good fertilization starts with the grass you have. We consider the turf alongside sunlight, moisture, and mowing so the plan supports healthy growth without adding more than the lawn needs.

features.title: Understand the lawn
features.body: Grass type, sunlight, moisture, and weed pressure all matter. Tell us where the lawn struggles so we can consider the conditions behind those thin spots or changes in color.

features.title: Apply with purpose
features.body: Seasonal liquid nutrition supports active turf growth. Weed prevention and targeted treatments address different weed pressures, using products appropriate for your grass and the conditions.

features.title: Keep care responsive
features.body: We track the lawn’s response, watch for insect and disease concerns, and adjust care as conditions change. Service photos and notes help you follow the work and understand any aftercare.

real_faqs.q: How often do you treat lawns in Plaquemine?
real_faqs.a: Our annual lawn program includes seasonal planned visits, generally about six weeks apart. Treatments vary with the season, turf condition, and weather. Each visit serves a purpose; eight visits do not mean eight identical fertilizer applications.

real_faqs.q: How much does the lawn program cost?
real_faqs.a: Your free estimate depends on the measured treatable lawn area, property conditions, and selected services. We explain the price and scope before you approve. The annual year-round lawn program price is divided into twelve monthly payments. Service is month-to-month with no long-term contract; monthly billing does not mean monthly treatments.

Yes. The lawn program combines seasonal weed prevention with targeted control of existing weeds. Product choices depend on the grass, weeds, weather, and label directions. Persistent weeds may require continued management or additional targeted treatment, which we review with you.

real_faqs.q: Which types of grass can you treat?
real_faqs.a: We work with warm-season lawns including centipede, St. Augustine, Bermuda, and zoysia. Nutrition and weed-control choices are adjusted to the grass and site conditions. If you do not know your grass type, include that in your estimate request.

real_faqs.q: Do you serve my Plaquemine address?
real_faqs.a: We provide lawn treatments in Plaquemine as part of our Iberville Parish service area. Send your street address and ZIP code so we can confirm availability and prepare pricing for the property. Our team can also check addresses in nearby communities.

real_faqs.q: How soon will I see a difference in my lawn?
real_faqs.a: Weed response and turf improvement depend on the species, growing conditions, and starting condition of the lawn. Some changes happen sooner than others, while thin areas need suitable growing conditions and time to fill in. We explain what to expect and review progress through the program.

real_faqs.q: Do I need to be home for treatment?
real_faqs.a: Usually not, as long as we can access the scheduled treatment area. Unlock gates, secure pets, and tell us about access restrictions or sensitive areas. We document the visit with photos and notes and provide directions for caring for the treated lawn.

real_faqs.q: When can children and pets return to the lawn?
real_faqs.a: Keep people and pets away from the treatment area during application. Follow the specific re-entry directions provided for the products used. A single waiting period does not apply to every treatment.

real_faqs.q: Should I water or mow after an application?
real_faqs.a: Follow the instructions provided with that visit. Watering and mowing timing depend on the products applied and the conditions. If you are unsure, contact our office before changing the aftercare plan.

real_faqs.q: Will fertilizer fix yellow grass or bare spots?
real_faqs.a: Not always. Shade, moisture, mowing, insects, disease, and soil conditions can affect the lawn. Tell us what you are seeing so we can review the cause and recommend an appropriate next step. Fertilizer cannot revive dead grass or correct drainage problems by itself.
